name: word_limit
description: Answer whether a piece of text is inside a word budget. Exits 0 either way, with the verdict on stdout as JSON.

text.description: The text to measure. Counted as whitespace-separated words, exactly as given.

max_words.description: The most words the text may contain. Written in the flow rather than templated: a rendered template is a string, and this has to be a number.

output_schema.description: The verdict. `verdict` is what a flow switches on; `reason` is what it tells the writer, and is null when there is nothing to say.

over.description: How far past the limit, and 0 when inside it.

exit_codes.0: answered (the verdict is on stdout as JSON, whether it approved or rejected)
exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is missing or the wrong type)
